page_title: MAI 1-1 UNI | Mainz v Union Berlin 24/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The match has just finished.
90+8' Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Harm Osmers had an easy-decision to make.
90+7' Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
90+5' Great chance! Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) controls a rebound inside the box. He only has the keeper to beat, but his shot flies just over the bar.
90+1' Laszlo Benes (Union Berlin) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
86' A corner kick by Union Berlin is thwarted by the well prepared Robin Zentner (Mainz).
85' We are about to witness a substitution. Nelson Weiper (Mainz) is replacing Kaishu Sano.
85' A substitution has been made. Anthony Caci goes off and Paul Nebel (Mainz) comes on.
84' Union Berlin take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
83' Bo Svensson is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Kevin Vogt suffers an injury and Leopold Querfeld (Union Berlin) comes on.
81' Kevin Vogt (Union Berlin) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
76' Bo Henriksen prepares a substitution. Karim Onisiwo is replaced by Armindo Sieb (Mainz).
74' 1 - 1 Laszlo Benes (Union Berlin) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and curls the ball inside the right post in trademark fashion.
72' Today's match ends for Benedict Hollerbach who will be replaced by Tim Skarke (Union Berlin).
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Laszlo Benes (Union Berlin) comes onto the pitch for Andras Schafer.
72' Here is a change. Christopher Trimmel is going off and Bo Svensson gives the last tactical orders to Janik Haberer (Union Berlin).
70' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
66' Harm Osmers couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Stefan Bell (Mainz) and blew his whistle.
65' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Yorbe Vertessen (Union Berlin) will replace Lucas Tousart.
65' Andreas Hanche-Olsen (Mainz) didn't manage to convert the resulting corner kick into a goal. He produced a header from a dangerous position inside the box, but he sent it well over the bar.
65' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) takes the corner.
64' Anthony Caci (Mainz) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. Mainz earn a corner.

60' Karim Onisiwo (Mainz) was the quickest one to orientate himself inside the box and rose high to reach a fine corner kick. He fails to direct the ball past the goalkeeper as it flies narrowly over the bar.
60' Anthony Caci (Mainz) is about to take a corner kick.
60' Robin Zentner (Mainz) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
56' Harm Osmers blows his whistle for a foul after Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) hacks down one of his opponents.

53' 1 - 0 Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) unleashes a beautiful rocket of a shot from a long-range free kick. The ball goes into the top left corner and leaves the goalkeeper beaten. This takes hours and hours on the training ground. The score is 1:0.
52' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) was quite harsh and Harm Osmers didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
51' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
51' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) takes the corner kick, but Frederik Ronnow reads it well and stops the effort.

50' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) picks up a lofted cross inside the box and fires a quick shot to the left post. His promising effort is kept out by Frederik Ronnow, who pulls off a stunning save! Mainz have been awarded a corner kick.
50' Anthony Caci (Mainz) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
48' Anthony Caci (Mainz) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
47' Karim Onisiwo (Mainz) pounces on a great cross inside the box, but lashes his powerful first-time shot inches over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Union Berlin.
46' Union Berlin are ruled offside.
46' The whistle blows and Harm Osmers starts the second half.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' Harm Osmers shows a yellow card to Lucas Tousart (Union Berlin) for his blatant foul.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
44' Karim Onisiwo (Mainz) leaps highest in the middle of the box to meet a lofted ball and powers a header at a goal, but unfortunately for him it flies just over the bar.
43' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

42' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball towards the crossbar. However, he couldn't beat Robin Zentner, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save.
42' The corner from Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) is hurriedly cleared.
40' The resulting set piece from Mainz is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
39' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
36' Half-chance! Karim Onisiwo (Mainz) plays a pass into the box, but Frederik Ronnow reacts well to snuff out the attack.
35' Harm Osmers has a clear sight and sees a foul from Diogo Leite (Union Berlin).
34' The corner kick from Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
31' Union Berlin have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
31' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Stefan Bell (Mainz) is coming onto the pitch as Maxim Leitsch cannot continue after picking up an injury.

30' The ball goes out of play. Union Berlin are awarded a corner kick. Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
25' Harm Osmers blows his whistle after Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
23' Union Berlin failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

22' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. Union Berlin force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

22' Jordan Siebatcheu (Union Berlin) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.

20' Kaishu Sano (Mainz) times his leap well to meet the lofted pass from Karim Onisiwo, but his close-range header slips just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.
19' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
15' Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
11' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
10' Kaishu Sano (Mainz) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. Mainz have been awarded a corner kick.
10' Anthony Caci (Mainz) serves up a nice cross, but Frederik Ronnow punches the ball away.
7' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) has tested the patience of referee Harm Osmers and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
7' Harm Osmers blows his whistle. Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) commits a foul after dangerous play.
6' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Mainz.
6' A cross into the box from Anthony Caci (Mainz) is cleared.
4' The Mainz players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
4' Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) jumps into a tackle and Harm Osmers signals a foul.
2' Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Mainz will have the kick-off.
Harm Osmers will officiate today.
